newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Lutai Textile plans 80 mln B share offer.
newsitem.headline: China's Lutai Textile plans 80 mln B share offer.

text.p: China's Lutai Textile Joint Stock Co Ltd said on Wednesday it would make an initial public offering of 80 million B shares priced at HK$1.93 per share.

The offer -- equal to 2.065 yuan per share -- would start on Thursday and end on August 5 with a listing eventually to be made on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange, said a company prospectus published in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times.
The company, based in Zibo city in the eastern province of Shandong, was expected to raise 150 million yuan in net proceeds to finance the expansion of its coloured cloth spinning project, it said.
China Southern Securities Co had been named as the chief domestic underwriter and Nikko Securities (Asia) Co would act as the international coordinator, the prospectus said.
